hits.about: VYB is a super luxury residential complex from the developer One Broker Group, located in the most popular and prestigious area of Business Bay, on the shore of the Dubai Water Canal, near the Godolphin Equestrian Club. The complex consists of a 17-storey building. The facades are designed in a modern style. Thanks to the graceful lines and open balconies with glass enclosures, the complex is a real architectural masterpiece, which offers an overview of the city center. The apartments for sale are 1 and 2 bedroom apartments with spacious and functional layouts. The interiors are made in a modern style with the use of beautiful shades, which creates a cozy atmosphere. The windows offer stunning views of the cityscapes.World-class amenities are provided for the residents, including a family recreation area, infinity pool, outdoor barbecue area, several gyms, including outdoor, playground and children's pool. The complex has its own park where you can run and walk with your family. There is security in the closed territory, concierge service employees will perform household errands.Business Bay has a developed infrastructure, thanks to which in close proximity to the complex residents will be able to find schools, kindergartens, medical centers, cafes, restaurants, stores. VYB is just 5 minutes from Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, 15 minutes to Emirates Shopping Center and 20 minutes to Palm Jumeirah Island.
hits.title: VYB
